asr.full_text: Earning passive income without spending hours, money, and too much effort is the goal for many people. What some of you may not know is that it's possible to do it through your ADA tokens. If you're a Cardano holder or intend to be, we believe this video will help a lot. Because we'll explain what staking Cardano is, how it works, and the step by step you need to do to join a Pool. And don't worry, we'll also explain what a Pool is. But before we begin our tutorial remember to subscribe to the channel and turn on post notifications also check our gifts and bonuses in the description to invest in cryptocurrencies with the best Market conditions now let's get right to the point of this video what is staking first of all I believe you need to understand what staking is, the method we'll use to earn passive income in ADA, Cardano's native token. Staking is a unique feature of some cryptocurrency blockchains. It's important to mention that staking is completely different to lending crypto. Staking is a way to earn rewards for holding certain cryptocurrency, specifically those that work by a proof of stake model. Cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin operate on a proof of work model to verify transactions. This model involves powerful computers solving complex mathematical equations to verify transactions. In such an ecosystem, miners do that. They compete against one another to be the first to solve problems, consuming a tremendous amount of electricity in the process. That's why those who are able to solve these puzzles, are rewarded with tokens of these cryptocurrencies. In other words, if you're a miner working in the Proof-of-Work model on Bitcoin's blockchain, then you'll be rewarded with bitcoins in exchange for your efforts. In proof-of-stake system, things work more like a lottery. In this lottery, each E ADA token is like a ticket, and everyone who participates can win the lottery, but of course, those with more ADA have more tickets and, thus, a better chance to win the lottery and get a reward. It's the process by which validators are selected to create a new block and process transactions. If you decide to stake your ADA for a set period of time, you'll periodically earn a return on your investment. Cardano addresses have separate keys for spending and staking. This means that if you decide to stake your ADA tokens, they will never leave your wallet. Furthermore, Cardano doesn't require your tokens to be locked in for a term and you can unstake your tokens at any time. This aspect sets Cardano apart from its competitors. Staking pools. Cardano relies heavily on staking pools, whereas some other blockchains rely heavily on individual staking nodes. Basically, pools are where you put money to be rewarded for investing in the blockchain, cooperating with the proof of stake model. Pools will ensure that Cardano's validator network stays large. Advanced users can run their pool to earn higher profits. On the other hand, individual users can stake their own pool to earn higher profits. On the other hand, individual users can stake their tokens with an existing stake pool, which is a much simpler process. What do you need to Join a Pool? To successfully join a pool, you will need to choose a pool that is reliable and which offers low fees. Websites like Pooltool and ADA pools allow users to view the status of each pool. Cardano's Dealtas Wall wallet also helps users to choose a pool through its Delegations screen. Once you've staked your ADA, you don't have to do anything at all – rewards are automatically paid out. Therefore, if you don't withdraw your original stake, your ADA will remain staked, and you will continue to earn rewards. Risks of Staking Being completely honest with you right now, staking ADA either directly or via a third party involves no more risk than simply holding it in a wallet. The only true risk is losing the wallet's private key, which is a risk with all cryptocurrencies regardless of whether or not staking is involved. You can also divide your stakes among different pools to diversify and avoid pools charging excessive fees. We believe that you don't need to worry. In our research, there's not even a clue that pool operators have a way of stealing your ADA. However, they can take most or all of the rewards from the pool by suddenly changing the margin to 99% or 100%, if they have malicious purposes. But the truth is that it's very difficult for something like that to happen. Step by step on how to stake Cardano. The best and most secure way to stake ADA is by using the Daedalus wallet. This wallet was actually developed by IOHK, the research company that built Cardano's ADA, so it definitely is the best option to stake this coin. Step 1. Download the Daedalus wallet Firstly, download Daedalus and create a wallet. Ensure that you are downloading the Daedalus app from the official website. The wallet can be downloaded in the latest version of Daedalus and create a wallet. Ensure that you are downloading the Daedalus app from the official website. The wallet can be downloaded in the latest version of Daedalus wallet for your operating system, be it Mac OS, Windows, or Linux. Note that there isn't a mobile version for this wallet, so don't download any suspicious app that pretends to be a Daedalus wallet. After the download has completed, double click the Installer package. The Daedalus installer package will unpack and install the Daedalus Wallet on your computer. Once the installation is complete, launch the Daedalus app on your computer using the Desktop icon. Then select your language, number, date and time format, and click Continue. You need to agree with Terms of Service for this next step, and if you agree with them, just tick the box at the bottom of the popup. Daedalus Wallet will open and show you the wallet dashboard. Then the Blockchain Synchronization will begin. Step 2. Create a new wallet From the Daedalus wallet dashboard click on create. Give the new wallet a name. Create a spending password. This password will be required each time you send ADA, delegate your wallet to a stake pool, or register for voting. Click on create Shelley wallet. Next, write down the 24-word deadaless wallet recovery phrase and pay close attention to this part. Don't ever think of saving your recovery phrase on your computer. Don't take a photo of it, and don't write it in any cellphone notes. Just save it offline. That's the safest way to store it. The reason is if you lose your 24-word deadalus wallet recovery phrase you will lose access to all your ADA. So write it down on paper or whatever. But just keep in mind that the offline solution is the best Also don't share this recovery phrase with anyone. That's the best way to be safe from malicious people, hackers and stuff like that. Finally, remember that the recovery phrase cannot be changed, reset or bypassed. After this step you are required to Verify the 24-Word Debtless Wallet Recovery Phrase. Enter the 24 words in the exact order. Start by typing the first few characters of the word, then use the mouse to click on the chosen word. From the Side menu choose Delegation Center. On the Delegation screen, click on Choose Stake center. From the side menu, choose delegation center on the delegation screen, click on choose stake pools from the top menu. Step four, search for a Cardano stake pool. In the search bar, type in the pool name that you want to delegate Ada to. After you find it, you can use the slider bar to match the size of your delegation and wallet to a suitable pool. Changing the size of your wallet will give you different options to delegate. Step 5. Delegate ADA. Click the number and ticker of the pool to see more information about that and select delegate if you're sure that you want to delegate ADA to that pool. Remember to choose a pool that isn't over saturated as your rewards will diminish. It's important to keep in mind that each time you delegate ADA to a pool, there is a small fee to start delegating or swapping from one to another. In case you don't know, Cardano staking operates on a cyclical basis. Rewards are paid out every epic something around every five days during the network's initial launch, there will be epochs in which no rewards are paid out once those steps have been done, everything you need to do is wait for your wallet to be staked and then rewards to be calculated the following epoch. Well that's it folks! Hope this tutorial has helped you, and if it has let us know by clicking the like button on this video. Also, If you want to see more crypto deals, remember to subscribe to our channel and turn on post notifications to see more videos about how your crypto will double your cash, with smart investment strategies, and if you're thinking about what to get for your crypto debt. And if you're looking for the best market conditions to trade sell or buy cryptos you should check our links in the description and enjoy our exclusive bonuses that being said thanks for watching this video and i'll be waiting for you in the next one foreign
